query_construction: controlled vocabulary mapping from public source ingredient fragments
methodological_note: Earlier query-generation pilots through v4.2 were rejected before relevance judgment because manual audit found objective input-quality issues, semantic over-normalization, or overlap with prior evaluation queries. v4.3 preserves kulit tahu and sosis ayam as distinct ingredients, rejects bakal tempe and separately referenced component-recipe fragments, and remains unseen to Dapuria at generation time.
rules: No Dapuria v4 outputs inspected before manual query audit and freeze
No recipe title used to construct query
Every query item must belong to the pre-specified controlled ingredient vocabulary
Target-category membership is explicit, not inferred from symmetric substring matching
Generic cooking media, branded seasoning, equipment, units, and preparation fragments are excluded from query vocabulary
No query ingredient set may overlap a previously used evaluation query after canonicalization
Distinct processed ingredient forms such as kulit tahu and sosis ayam are preserved rather than collapsed to generic ingredients
Separately referenced component recipes and source-specific intermediate ingredients are excluded
No query may be removed or replaced based on Dapuria performance
Source recipe is not treated as a corpus ground-truth recipe ID
freeze_rule: Do not edit, regenerate, remove, or replace any v4.3 query after this freeze. Any subsequent Dapuria result must be evaluated on this exact CSV hash.
